S1_version.notes: No --version flag. Returns error: Unknown command. npm list shows no local install (runs via npx).

S2_help.notes: Full help with 8 command groups: markets, orders, portfolio, account, questions, guides, ecosystem, shell. Plus onboarding: setup, approve, deposit.

S3_auth.notes: API key from keychain works via --api-key flag. portfolio balance returns structured data. CONTEXT_API_KEY env var did NOT work in subshell — must use explicit --api-key flag.

S4_balance.notes: 4 USDC in settlement balance (4000000 units), 0 in wallet. Structured JSON with tokenAddress, balance, settlementBalance, walletBalance.

D1_list.notes: Returns paginated market list with full detail. Supports --limit, --sort-by, --status, --category, --cursor filters.

D2_get.notes: Full market detail with 30 fields: outcomePrices (bid/ask/spread/mid), metadata (categories, criteria, sourceAccounts), resolution info, deadline.

D3_pricing.notes: Dedicated orderbook endpoint with YES/NO sides, price/size levels, timestamp. Also quotes endpoint available. Market data includes bestBid/bestAsk/spread/midPrice per outcome.

D4_search.notes: Text search works, returns relevant results. Supports --limit and --offset for pagination.

D5_schema_consistency.notes: All 3 tested markets have identical 30-key schema. Fully consistent.

T1_simulate.notes: Two simulate paths work: (1) markets simulate gives quick USD-based estimate with estimatedContracts/avgPrice/slippage/warnings, (2) orders simulate gives detailed fill analysis with levels/summary/collateral/warnings. Both are read-only.

T2_limit_order.notes: Requires CONTEXT_PRIVATE_KEY (wallet signer), not just API key. Clean error: 'A private key is required for trading operations.' No longer returns 403.

T3_cancel.notes: SKIP — depends on T2. CLI supports: orders cancel <nonce>, orders bulk-cancel --nonces, orders cancel-replace.

T4_market_order.notes: Same as T2 — private key required. Dedicated 'orders market' subcommand with --max-price and --max-size.

E1_huge_amount.notes: Handles gracefully. Returns estimate with warnings: LOW_LIQUIDITY, HIGH_SLIPPAGE, INSUFFICIENT_COLLATERAL. No crash.

E2_invalid_inputs.notes: Returns structured JSON errors. Private key check fires before input validation, so cannot fully test input validation without signer.

E4_recovery.notes: After all error scenarios, markets list works immediately. Stateless CLI, no corruption.

metadata.authMethod: API key (--api-key flag) + private key (--private-key flag) for trading
metadata.gradeChange: C -> B (403 issue resolved, CLI restructured)

keyFindings: CLI has been significantly restructured since last test — hierarchical commands, richer API
Previous 403 Forbidden errors are GONE — trading now fails with clean 'private key required' error
Discovery is excellent: list, search, get, orderbook, quotes, simulate, price-history all work
Two simulation paths: quick USD-based (markets simulate) and detailed fill analysis (orders simulate)
Trading requires CONTEXT_PRIVATE_KEY (wallet signer) in addition to API key — dual auth model
Bulk operations available: bulk-create, bulk-cancel, combined bulk endpoint
All output is clean JSON with structured errors — highly parseable for agents
Balance shows 4 USDC in settlement, enough for small test trades if private key were available
Schema is consistent across markets (30 fields), rich metadata with resolution criteria and source accounts

blockers.description: No private key configured — cannot execute any trades (limit, market, cancel)
blockers.resolution: Set CONTEXT_PRIVATE_KEY env var or pass --private-key flag with wallet's private key

blockers.description: No --version flag to verify installed CLI version
blockers.resolution: Minor — use npm list or check package.json

blockers.description: CONTEXT_API_KEY env var not picked up in subshell execution — must use explicit --api-key flag
blockers.resolution: Use --api-key flag explicitly or write to ~/.config/context/config.env

agentReadiness.summary: Highly agent-friendly for discovery and simulation. Trading blocked only by missing private key, not by API/platform limitations. Once private key is configured, all trading features (limit, market, cancel, bulk) should work. The 403 issue from last test is fully resolved.
